fact: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 of 23 January 2024, in force on signature, requires payment institutions in the UMOA to disclose fees, run an internal complaints system answering within 7 working days, and lets users escalate to the Commission Bancaire or to mediation by the national Observatoire de la Qualité des Services Financiers.
title: Instruction N°001-01-2024 relative aux services de paiement dans l'UMOA
